page_title: RAY 2-0 BET | Rayo Vallecano v Betis 17/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Juan Pulido is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
90+4' William Carvalho (Betis) has tested the patience of referee Juan Pulido and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.

89' Nice individual effort by Isco (Betis). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the middle of the goal, but Stole Dimitrievski does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
88' Betis take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
87' Isco (Betis) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
87' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Juan Pulido stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
85' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
85' Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) is able to continue to play.
85' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) gets a yellow card.
83' The game is interrupted. Isco (Betis) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
83' Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
82' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. Rodri (Betis) replaces Pablo Fornals.
82' Substitution. Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ayoze Perez walks off.
78' 2 - 0 Goal! Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 2:0.
78' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Jorge de Frutos is replaced by Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano).
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) is replacing Unai Lopez.
77' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) was too forceful with his tackle and Juan Pulido interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
77' The attendance is 13264.
76' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
75' Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
74' The game is interrupted now, Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
70' A corner kick by Rayo Vallecano is thwarted by the well prepared Rui Silva (Betis).
70' The resulting set piece from Rayo Vallecano is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Rayo Vallecano can continue in their attacking effort.
69' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) sends a rebound goalwards towards the top of the net, but the goalkeeper is there in time to stop it.
68' Substitution. Pep Chavarria is replaced by Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano).
68' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with William Carvalho (Betis) replacing Nabil Fekir.
68' Substitution. Willian Jose walks off the pitch and Assane Diao (Betis) comes on as a substitute.
68' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rayo Vallecano comes to nothing.
67' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
67' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.
66' Betis take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Betis are awarded a corner kick.

66' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Betis will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
63' The game is interrupted as Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is flagged offside.
62' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Rui Silva.
60' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Raul de Tomas will be replaced by Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pathe Ciss is coming onto the pitch as Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
59' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
59' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
57' Pablo Fornals (Betis) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
54' Here is a change. Johnny is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Isco (Betis).

53' Pablo Fornals (Betis) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
52' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Juan Pulido blows his whistle for a foul. Betis are awarded a free kick.
49' Rough tackle by Juan Miranda (Betis). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Betis failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
47' Betis fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air. The referee blows his whistle, Betis are awarded a corner kick.

47' Pablo Fornals (Betis) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
45+2' Surely that's handball by one of the Betis players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' The free kick is taken by Nabil Fekir (Betis), but ball is cleared.
43' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:0.
40' 1 - 0 Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) sets the ball for the free kick and fires in a beautiful strike, which nestles exactly in the top right corner.
40' Johnny (Betis) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
38' Johnny (Betis) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by German Pezzella (Betis) was quite harsh and Juan Pulido didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
37' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Juan Pulido has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
35' The foul by Juan Miranda (Betis) was seen by Juan Pulido who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
34' Ayoze Perez (Betis) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
31' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
29' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
29' Ayoze Perez (Betis) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Pulido had an easy-decision to make.
28' Juan Pulido shows a yellow card to Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
27' Betis can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
27' Johnny (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Good work from Betis as they win a corner.
24' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
24' Nabil Fekir (Betis) commits a rough foul. Juan Pulido stops the game and makes a call. Rayo Vallecano earn a free kick.
22' Nabil Fekir (Betis) gets to a rebound on the edge of the box and strikes, but he only hits the left post and wastes a promising chance!
21' Juan Pulido couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) and blew his whistle.
17' The corner is swung in but Betis can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
17' Nabil Fekir (Betis) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away. The ball goes out of play. Betis are awarded a corner kick.
16' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Betis win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
15' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) takes a long run up and launches the free kick towards goal from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall bravely blocks the effort.
15' German Pezzella (Betis) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Juan Pulido blows for a foul. Rayo Vallecano earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
11' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
8' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
8' German Pezzella (Betis) makes a rough challenge and Juan Pulido blows his whistle for a foul. Rayo Vallecano have a free kick.
5' The ball is cleared out of defence to the edge of the box where Ayoze Perez (Betis) hits a first-time shot back towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball flashes well past the right post.
3' Ayoze Perez (Betis) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
1' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Betis will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Juan Pulido.
